incident.name: Kaseya VSA Ransomware
incident.description: REvil exploited zero-day in Kaseya VSA to push ransomware to 1,500+ businesses via MSPs. $70M ransom demanded.
incident.root_cause: Zero-day in widely-used MSP software, supply chain amplification
incident.lessons: MSP software is a force multiplier for attackers. Vendor security assessments are critical.
